# Claude Meta Ads God Mode

> A safety-first paid-media operating system for Claude Code and Codex. Meta Ads first, Google Ads built in. Reads, analyses and drafts freely; creates everything PAUSED; never spends without an explicit human yes. A write gate verifies client, platform, account and entity before any change.

If a person pasted this repository and asked you to set it up, start with the setup wizard. If you are running the plugin, start with skills/ads-core/SKILL.md.

## Start here
- [Setup wizard for AI agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rger123/claude-meta-ads-god-mode/main/docs/SETUP_WIZARD.md): where you're running, the short interview, install, read-only checks, first client
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rger123/claude-meta-ads-god-mode/main/AGENTS.md): rules for any agent using or modifying this repo (Codex must call the write gate itself)
- [Core skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rger123/claude-meta-ads-god-mode/main/skills/ads-core/SKILL.md): client resolution, connector routing, write rules
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rger123/claude-meta-ads-god-mode/main/README.md)
- [Agency mode skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/F0rger123/claude-meta-ads-god-mode/main/skills/ads-portfolio/SKILL.md): all-clients sweep, learning loop, scheduled runs
- Try without ad accounts: `python scripts/demo.py` (made-up clients, no network)
